building: Helen B. Schleman Hall of Student Services (SCHL)
provider: Purdue University Board of Trustees / Administrative Operations
document_title: Approval to Plan, Finance, Construct and Award Construction Contracts for Schleman Hall, Stewart Center and Related Renovations; Exhibit B
observations: The official Exhibit B shows floor plans for basement and Levels 1–3.
Plans show a multi-wing footprint, central circulation/stair/elevator cores, offices and open collaborative/meeting areas.
The first-floor plan records a lobby/entry and common circulation zones.
The 2021 board document says the planned Schleman renovation was scheduled for completion in May 2024; its drawings describe pre-renovation/planning context.
model_use: Added embedded schematic interior partitions and service-core volumes informed by the plan organization. Internal partitions are simplified and not dimensionally traced to the GIS outline; the exterior remains authoritative to the GIS building footprint.
limits: Plans are design/space-planning drawings and are not georeferenced to the campus footprint ring.
They document the 2021 renovation plan, not verified current room partitions after the 2024 renovation.
No exact partition dimensions, vertical elevations or interior finish specifications were inferred.
